items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR after imaging and specialist consults; consensus is week-to-week with team and player aiming for return ASAP. Only ruled out this weekend vs Seahawks; Marcus Mariota starts.
items.why: Imaging evaluated, multiple specialists consulted; positive consensus vs prior uncertainty.
items.implication: Short-term Mariota start; Daniels return timeline flexible, not multi-week IR.
items.opportunity: McLaurin and WAS pass-catchers with Mariota (historical 25% tgt share).

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers DNP Wed/Thu (hamstring); updates indicate may miss Sunday (Brazil). Day-to-day but trending out second straight.
items.why: No practice progress on aggravated hamstring (orig Aug 20).
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining Ravens pass-catchers.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins DNP Wed/Thu (hamstring); expected to miss second game, sources note Grade 1 but no practice.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs; Ryans watching progress but sources lean miss.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz 30% routes/tgt share sans Collins + Colts TE-friendly matchup.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua DNP second straight day (hip); Rapoport notes may miss Sunday vs Broncos. Trending toward another absence.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hip/groin; McVay notes soft-tissue lack of clarity.
items.implication: High risk OUT Week 3; Adams elevated.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams routes/targets spike without Nacua.

items.text: Packers WRs first game sans Jayden Reed (neck/back): Watson 45 routes, Golden 44, Moore 27 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson+Golden 48% Love targets YTD.
items.why: Reed absence opens routes; Watson/Golden dominate.
items.implication: Watson clear WR1 upside with Reed out.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 tgts/8% share through 3 games. Historical: 33% TPRR without London on field vs 17% with.
items.why: Low route % and target share; dependent on London absence for upside.
items.implication: Pitts fringe TE; London presence caps him.
items.opportunity: Monitor London status for Pitts spike.

items.text: 49ers DE Nick Bosa calf injury in Thursday practice; expected miss few weeks including vs Cardinals, IR TBD. Sixth DL down recently.
items.implication: SF pass rush depleted; Cardinals offense boost possible.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite prop + soft run D matchup.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% tgt share last week sans Collins (30% routes); IND 4th-most yds to TEs.
items.why: Proven target spike + TE-friendly matchup with Collins out.

items.text: Loves Christian Watson vs ATL: WR8 utilization, 38% RZ tgt share; WR9 PPG since Wk11 last year.
items.why: Strong utilization + red-zone role; Reed absence boosts further (per Levitan).

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches +15% tgt share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit tgts both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep efficiency vs soft secondary.
items.opportunity: Target share and aDOT locked in.

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest FPts to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total (17). Mariota history solid but matchup tanks.
items.why: Brutal secondary + low team total despite Mariota history (25% share).
items.conflict: Historical Mariota production vs this matchup.
